guide.title: Follow one merchant task
guide.titleZh: 跟着一个商家任务走一遍
intro: Start in the ordinary workspace, then switch on Pling and ask for the same work. The simulation keeps the original pages and handlers; Pling adds a narrow assistant layer.
Try a student lookup, ask where to add a teacher, or request the next three Tuesdays at 13:00.
introZh: 先在普通工作台里看看页面，再切换到 Pling 接入版提出同样的需求。业务页面和处理函数保持原样，Pling 增加的是一层受限的助手能力。
可以查询学员、询问新增老师入口，或要求安排接下来三周周二 13:00 的团课。

steps.title: See the existing business screens
steps.titleZh: 先看页面本来就有的业务界面
steps.body: The course catalogue, separate detail and editor screens, teacher list, scheduling dialogs, students, and membership cards belong to the ordinary application.
steps.bodyZh: 课程列表、独立详情与编辑页、老师列表、排课弹窗、学员和会员卡都属于原有应用。

steps.title: Look up a student without exposing an ID
steps.titleZh: 按姓名查学员，不要求用户提供 ID
steps.body: The assistant uses the same narrow business API as the page. Duplicate names are returned as masked candidates for the user to disambiguate.
steps.bodyZh: 助手调用页面共用的窄业务 API。遇到重名时返回脱敏候选，由用户确认具体学员。

steps.title: Preview a repeating schedule before writing
steps.titleZh: 重复排课先预览，再写入
steps.body: The preview computes dates in Asia/Shanghai and checks teacher and room conflicts. The confirmed write recalculates and validates the whole series again.
steps.bodyZh: 预览按 Asia/Shanghai 计算日期并检查老师、教室冲突；用户确认后，写入操作会重新计算并复核整组排期。

steps.title: Ask where to add a teacher
steps.titleZh: 问新增老师入口在哪里
steps.body: The assistant highlights the real button. The locate-only declaration does not click it or submit the form.
steps.bodyZh: 助手会高亮页面上的真实按钮。只定位声明不会替用户点击或提交表单。

guide.note: This is a simulated business API, not a live connection to Icegrass. Replace the mock service with the application's existing authenticated API before using the integration pattern in production.
guide.noteZh: 这是模拟业务 API，并未连接真实冰草系统。生产接入时，应替换为应用已有的、经过身份校验的业务 API。
